title: 25 years after 9/11: Counterterrorism continues to undermine the rule of law

title: Bayeux Tapestry draws flocks in London seeking story 'etched in memory'
subhead: The first visitors admired the Bayeux Tapestry at the British Museum on Thursday. The work is on loan from France to the United Kingdom until July 2027. Public interest reflects both the importance of William the Conqueror's accession to the English throne in the national story and the fascination of seeing a nearly 1,000-year-old tapestry.

title: French economy falls behind rest of Europe: Slow growth, rising inflation and unemployment
subhead: Growth is not expected to exceed 0.4% in 2026, down from the previously forecast 0.7%, according to the French National Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies.
